verdict.rationale_short: The June 14 Islamabad Declaration — Trump authorized toll-free Hormuz reopening, US naval blockade removed, VP Vance and Iran Parliament Speaker Qalibaf signed — has triggered the BUY upgrade condition explicitly defined in the June 12 night brief. VIX 17.68 pre-market (below 18 trigger for the first time in this briefing cycle), Brent $83.25 (-4.7%, $13.75 below the $97 regime trigger), 30Y 4.97% (first close below 5.00% threshold confirmed by Fed H.15), DXY 99.52, and S&P 500 futures +1.2% all confirm regime clearance — the first simultaneous clearing of all five indicators since this briefing began. Conviction is medium, not high: Warsh's June 17 FOMC first press conference — potentially without the dot plot — remains structurally unpredictable and prevents a full conviction upgrade. HIGH conviction requires two consecutive SPX closes above 7,460 AND a neutral Warsh FOMC outcome.

bear_case: The market is gap-opening 1.2% on an MOU that still requires physical Hormuz reopening, Iranian hardliner ratification, and 60-day sanctions implementation — structural elements all three prior ceasefire frameworks had in various forms before collapsing. The S&P 500 forward P/E at 22.66x (83rd historical percentile) makes the 7,520 implied open expensive: BUY is the regime call, not a license to pay any entry price. The week's defining risk event remains Warsh's June 17 FOMC press conference: without the dot plot, markets have no historical template for interpreting a first Warsh presser, and a single hawkish or opaque sentence could push the 30Y back to 5.10–5.20% and erase the Iran deal yield tailwind within hours. A Warsh hawkish surprise combined with Iranian hardliner resistance to Hormuz implementation — the two concurrent worst-case conditions — would send SPX from 7,520 back to 7,280–7,350 before Juneteenth, converting the Iran deal gap into a confirmed bull trap. **If the 30Y re-breaches 5.05% after the Warsh FOMC June 17 presser AND Brent closes above $90 on two consecutive sessions, BUY converts to HOLD immediately — do not wait for a weekly close.**
